get.summary: Returns a sequence of measurements
get.description:
Each sequence item contains a reduced set of information about a single measurement; just the metadata,
but no detailed information about the results or the measurement specification.
            
The request supports filtering and pagination. The sort order of the returned sequence is oldest to newest.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limits the amount of measurement to return. Number must be between 0 and int.MaxValue

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description:
Sets the starting offset of the retrieved measurements. For example,
if offset is set to 10, the first 10 measurements will be skipped.
Number must be between 0 and int.MaxValue.

parameters.name: FromTimestamp
parameters.description:
Filter items that were created AFTER the provided timestamp.
            
For example, if 2021-11-30 is specified, only items performed after
2021-11-30 00:00 (local time) will be returned.

parameters.name: apc_ToTimestamp
parameters.description:
Filter items that were created BEFORE the provided timestamp.
            
For example, if 2021-11-30 is specified, only items performed before
2021-11-30 00:00 (local time) will be returned.

parameters.description:
Specifies the starting number of completed measurements from which we can fetch following completed measurements.
For example the request: "api/v1/measurements/completed?limit=3&apc_fromMeasurementCompletionNo=8"

you need to request GET api/v1/measurements/completed/latest, which will response with MeasurementCompletionNo
of latest completed (fully signed) measurement.

CheckResult.description:
[API 100] Defines how a check result is represented. A check result provides information about the comparison of a
measured value with a defined target value and limits.

id.description: [API 100] An identifier indicating the quantity that has been checked.

name.description: [API 100] The translated display name of the quantity that has been checked. Affected by Accept-Language Header.

names.description:
[API 100] The translated display names of the quantity that has been checked for all available languages. Available
if requested by Include-Languages Header.

unit.description: [API 100] The unit symbol of the user-selected unit of the quantity that has been checked.

quantity.description: [API 100] The physical quantity of the quantity that has been checked.

digits.description: [API 100] The number of digits after the decimal point for the numeric value, i.e. "2". Applies to the given unit.

precision.description: [API 100] The precision of the numeric value, i.e. "0.01". Applies to the given unit.

targetValue.description: [API 100] The target numeric value that is used as baseline for comparing with the measured value.

measuredValue.description: [API 100] The actual measured numeric value that is compared with the target value.

lowerLimit.description: [API 100] The lower limit numeric value that is used for assessing the measured value.

upperLimit.description: [API 100] The upper limit numeric value that is used for assessing the measured value.

assessment.description:
[API 100] The outcome for the checked quantity indicating whether the measured value is within given limits. For a
list of valid values refer to WellKnownCheckAssessment.

additional.description: [API 100] A list of additional attributes expressed as key/value pairs.

CheckLatest.description: [API 100] Represents information about the latest, most-recent check.

dataRevision.description:
[API 100] The revision of the checks database. This number is incremented each time the
database is modified. That allows consumers to determine whether changes have occurred between
two calls. It's possible that the value is reset to 0 on the next instrument startup.

checkNo.description:
[API 100] The check number of the latest, most-recent check. If there are no checks at all,
then 0 is returned. Otherwise, the returned number starts at 1 and is increased by 1 for every
new check. Implementations that can't provide strictly, consecutively increasing numbers, for
example, because they return checks gathered from multiple sources (instruments), should skip
that field.

apc_measurementCompletionNo.description: [APC 120] The measurement number of the latest, most-recent check that has been completed.

AuditTrailEntry.description:
[API 110] Defines how an audit-trail entry is represented.
A single audit-trail entry can have zero or more comments.

id.description: [API 110] The globally unique identifier of the audit-trail entry.

entryNo.description:
[API 110] The number of the entry in the audit trail. This is a strictly,
consecutively increasing number starting by 1. The number is unique only in the context
of a single instrument..

categoryId.description: [API 110] The ID of the audit-trail category this entry belongs to.

categoryName.description:
[API 110] The translated name of the audit-trail category this entry belongs to.
Affected by Accept-Language Header.

categoryNames.description:
[API 110] The translated names for all languages of the audit-trail category this entry belongs to.
Available if requested by Include-Languages Header.

typeId.description: [API 110] The ID of the type this audit-trail entry represents.

typeName.description:
[API 110] The translated name of the type this audit-trail entry represents.
Affected by Accept-Language Header.

typeNames.description:
[API 110] The translated names for all languages of the type this audit-trail entry represents.
Available if requested by Include-Languages Header.

timestamp.description: [API 110] The date/time when the entry was created and written to the audit trail.

text.description: [API 110] The message text of the audit-trail entry.

user.description: [API 110] The user that caused this audit-trail entry to be written.

exported.description: [API 110] A boolean value indicating whether the audit-trail entry has been marked as exported.

comments.description: [API 110] A list of comments made on this audit-trail entry.

AuditTrailEntryComment.description: [API 110] Comment made on this audit-trail entry.

id.description: [API 110] The globally unique identifier of the comment.

commentNo.description:
[API 110] The number of the comment on the audit-trail entry. This is a strictly, consecutively
increasing number starting by 1.
The number is unique only in the context of this single audit-trail entry.

timestamp.description: [API 110] The date/time when the comment was made.

user.description: [API 110] The user that made the comment.

text.description: [API 110] The comment text the user entered.

AuditTrailEntriesLatest.description:
[API 110] Returns information like the entry number (see AuditTrailEntryDto) of the latest,
most-recent entry stored in the audit-trail.

dataRevision.description:
[API 110] This number is incremented each time the dataset is modified. That allows consumers 
to determine whether changes have occurred between two calls.
The value may be reset to 0 on the next instrument startup.

entryNo.description:
[API 110] The entry number (see AuditTrailEntryDto) of the latest, most-recent audit-trail entry.
If there are no audit-trail entries at all, then 0 is returned.
Otherwise, the returned number starts at 1 and is increased by 1 for every new audit-trail entry.

instrumentName.description: A user-defined name of the instrument.

A stable identifier used for the identification of the instrument type.
Identifies a specific instrument model or type like the "DMA/501" or the "DMA/1001".

familyId.description:
A stable identifier used for the identification of the instrument family.
Identifies the instrument family, like "DMA/MR" or "DMA/HR".

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the instrument.

softwareChecksum.description: The checksum (hash) of the software running on the instrument.

firmwareChecksum.description: The checksum (hash) of the firmware running on the instrument.

manufacturer.description: Usually "Anton Paar GmbH". Third-party instruments might return a different manufacturer.

typeName.description: The user-friendly product name of the module type.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the module.

softwareVersion.description: The version of the software running on the module. Might contain a SemVer 2.0 version string like "1.2.3-alpha.1+fieldtest".

firmwareVersion.description: The version of the firmware running on the module. Might contain a SemVer 2.0 version string like "1.2.3-alpha.1+fieldtest".

hardwareVersion.description: The hardware version/revision of the module. Might contain a SemVer 2.0 version string like "1.2.3-alpha.1+fieldtest".

softwareChecksum.description: The checksum (hash) of the software running on the module.

firmwareChecksum.description: The checksum (hash) of the firmware running on the module.

active.description:
Indicates whether the module is active.
If False, this indicates that the module is connected, but does not take part in measurements.

modules.description: A list of embedded or connected sub-modules.

Capability.description: Returns a list of key/value pairs describing the capabilities of the instrument.

supportsAdjustments.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports fetching adjustments.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/adjustments/completed is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsAuditTrail.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports fetching audit-trail entries.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/audittrail/entries is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsChecks.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports fetching checks.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/checks/completed is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsMeasurements.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports fetching measurements.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/measurements/completed is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsRunningMeasurements.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports running (starting, aborting) measurements.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/measurements/running is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsProducts.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports fetching products.
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/products is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

supportsRunningChecks.description:
Indicates whether the instrument supports running (starting, aborting) checks (check measurements).
If true, then the API sub-set at api/v1/checks/running is available.
If absent, then consider it as false.

id.description: The globally unique identifier of the product.

productNo.description:
The number of the product.
The number is unique only in the context of a single instrument.

productName.description:
A user-defined name of the product.
This name is not guaranteed to be unique, neither globally nor in the context of a single instrument.

description.description:
A longer description of the product.
Might be an empty string, if not available.
